analysis.title: GS Novak - GS U.S. Industrials & Materials | CPI | transports | EPS | ORLY
key_insights: US markets were steady pre-market after a broad move higher on 11/9. Overseas, KOSPI was up 439bps, Japan up 287bps and Europe broadly green led by Germany. SHCOMP was flat.

China October exports grew 35.2% y/y (vs 36.3% in September). Imports grew 41.6% y/y (vs 31% in September), driven largely by energy products. The trade surplus narrowed to US$105.3bn (NSA) from US$133.5bn.

Crude continues a sharp decline with WTI at $85 and Brent at $90, both at local lows. Precious metals are lower. The 10-year was steady at 4.89%, the dollar was similar, and Bitcoin fell 100bps to $74k.
Fed's Waller was hawkish, backing a December rate hike with 50bps on the table if inflation keeps accelerating. October CPI is a key milestone today.

GS expects October core CPI of +0.16% (vs +0.2% consensus) and headline CPI of +0.21% (vs +0.3% consensus), reflecting higher food and energy prices. This is consistent with a 0.23% increase in core PCE.

GS component expectations for CPI: airfares unchanged m/m, medical services -0.1% (health insurance -2.5% on updated BLS source data), and slower autos inflation (used cars -1.5%, new cars +0.1%, auto insurance -0.3%).
NFIB came in at 97.8, in line with last month and slightly below consensus.

ENTG analyst day targets a 15% long-term revenue CAGR, 55% gross margin, 35% operating margin and a 30% EPS CAGR, with a $500mm buyback. GFL rejected a $52 offer from a private equity consortium. GE signed a $12.9bn jet engine deal.

EMBJ Q3 EBIT was $255mm vs $218mm on revenue of $2.35bn vs $2.20bn, with FCF of $628mm and a $36bn firm backlog. It raised its full-year revenue midpoint to $8.5bn from $8.3bn and raised FCF materially.
AAON Q3 EPS was $0.83 vs $0.57 and revenue was $707mm vs $601mm consensus. It raised full-year revenue growth to 72-75% from 55-60%, with a 17% implied move into the 5pm call.

Other prints: CWST in line to slightly light, EQPT well ahead on preannounced numbers, FWRD beat on EBITDA, LCID missed on revenue and EBITDA loss, and RKLB beat on revenue but guided Q4 EBITDA loss worse than consensus.

Transports desk view: rails are the most owned and look most vulnerable as the odds of M&A getting done decline. Rails are up 25-35% YTD and the desk sees more risk than reward in the group in up and down markets.
Parcel is under-owned. The desk prefers FDX over UPS as a pair trade and views UPS as a source of funds after the recent bounce. A new CFO at FDX could bring capital deployment into focus.

Trucking is mixed. KNX stands out with a better-than-feared quarter. In LTL, FDXF has the most optionality, XPO's pricing has slowed for several quarters, ODFL needs volume improvement and SAIA looks binary. In asset-light, EXPD has outperformed ahead of next week's analyst day, while CHRW sits at lows.
ORLY: after hosting the CFO post-earnings, GS maintains its Buy rating. It sees ORLY taking share, particularly in DIFM, and accelerating buybacks while reinvesting in the business.

earnings_insights: AAON Q3 EPS reported $0.83 vs consensus $0.57, revenue $707mm vs consensus $601mm, gross margin 26.7%, EBIT $100mm. Full-year revenue growth guided to 72-75% vs 55-60% prior, gross margin 26% vs 25-26% prior. Call at 5pm with 17% implied move.

CWST Q3 EBITDA reported $134mm vs consensus $136mm on sales of $559mm vs consensus $563mm. Full-year EBITDA guided to $475-481mm vs $473-483mm prior (same midpoint), with revenue at the high end of $2.1-2.11bn. 7% implied move, call at 10am.

EQPT preannounced. Q3 revenue $1.47bn vs consensus $1.31bn, EBITDA $594mm vs consensus $497mm. Gross margin below 31.5% vs 32.7% expected, EBITDA margin 40.5% vs 37.8% expected. Reaffirms guidance from October 19. Call at 8:30am with 13% implied move.
FWRD Q3 EBITDA reported $102mm vs consensus $88mm, revenue $674mm vs consensus $666mm. Q3 liquidity improved to $446mm. Call at 4:30pm with 9% implied move.

LCID Q3 revenue reported $350mm vs consensus $394mm. EBITDA loss $726mm vs consensus loss of $630mm. Runway extends into Q4 2027 after PIF increased its loan by $1.75bn. Call at 5:30pm with 17% implied move.
RKLB Q3 EBITDA loss reported $18mm vs consensus loss of $20mm, revenue $268mm vs consensus $258mm. Q4 EBITDA loss guided to $14-20mm vs consensus loss of $10mm. Call at 5pm with 12% implied move.

EMBJ Q3 EBIT reported $255mm vs consensus $218mm on revenue of $2.35bn vs consensus $2.20bn. FCF $628mm, firm backlog $36bn. Full-year revenue midpoint raised to $8.5bn from $8.3bn, and FCF raised materially.
ENTG analyst day: 15% long-term topline CAGR, 55% gross margin, 35% operating margin and 30% EPS CAGR targets. $500mm share repurchase announced.

ORLY: post-earnings meeting with the CFO covered elevated 3Q SG&A, higher SG&A per store in the FY26 outlook, gross margin headwinds from higher motor oil costs, and accelerating unit growth. Buy rating maintained.

Upcoming earnings this week: pre-market on 11/10 ALH, EMBJ, JBI, TDG. Post-market on 11/10 ATRO, FLY, MRCY, REZI, RGTI. On 11/11 AADX pre-market, and AVEX, CAE, CTVA, TTEK post-market. On 11/12 AIRO, DPC, FPS, LGN, LUNR pre-market, and HAWK, SPCE, YSS post-market. Desk focus is TDG and its guide.
